jobs.prompt: One soft, gently curved bird feather lying diagonally (quill at the lower left, tip at the upper right): a golden-yellow vane that warms to orange and a soft coral tip, a few playful separated barbs near the quill, a cream quill. It joins the existing treasure set (coconut, hazelnut, coral hibiscus flower, turquoise pebble, peach spiral shell, blueberry bunch) and must look like part of the same painted kit: same outline weight, softness, light and scale of detail. Its silhouette must read clearly at 80 px and differ from every existing treasure, because unfound treasures are shown as a flat silhouette in the collection. Square 1024x1024 canvas; the assembled object is centred and fills about 70% of the canvas, with generous transparent margins on every side. Polished 2D cartoon illustration matching the Gigantosaurus TV series and the existing Dino Mazes painted kit: softly shaded dimensional shapes, crisp clean antialiased outlines, warm light from the upper left, rich but not oversaturated colour. TRUE transparent alpha background (no checkerboard, no matte, no halo, no floor shadow). No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
jobs.lore: Miłka/Tiny paints with it when her brush falls apart; Czupur/Rocky wants to fly with it.
